components.css: .ds-p { font: 400 17.5px/1.62 Literata, Georgia, serif; color: var(--ink, #1D2340); } .ds-cite { display: inline-block; min-width: 1.7em; padding: 0 .32em; margin: 0 .06em; text-align: center; background: var(--pink, #FF48B0); color: var(--ink, #1D2340); font: 700 .74em/1.55 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: .08em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: background-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-cite:hover { background: var(--overprint, #002284); color: #fff; } .ds-cite:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #0078BF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-item { position: relative; padding: 20px 0 22px 88px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(29, 35, 64, .16); color: var(--ink, #1D2340); } .ds-item:focus, .ds-item:target { outline: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 72, 176, .13), transparent 70%); } .ds-item-n { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 14px; width: 68px; text-align: right; font: 900 44px/1 Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 70%; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--pink-deep, #E0137E); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-item-t { margin: 0; font: 700 20px/1.28 Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-item-t a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-item-t a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--pink, #FF48B0); text-decoration-thickness: 2.5px; } .ds-item-m { margin: 6px 0 10px; font: 500 12.5px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--blue-text, #00639F); } .ds-item-s { margin: 0; max-width: 68ch; font: 400 16.5px/1.62 Literata, Georgia, serif; } .ds-item-f { margin: 10px 0 0; padding-left: 1.1em; font: 400 16px/1.62 Literata, serif; } .ds-item-f li::marker { content: '\25A0  '; color: var(--pink, #FF48B0); font-size: .7em; }

narrative.overview:
Every page is a sheet off a small risograph press that owns exactly two drums: fluorescent pink and riso blue. Ink is spent loudly in the frame (a pink flood masthead, a dense blue issue band, blue topic floods, a pink back cover) and sparingly in the reading column, which stays calm paper and dark ink so a week of research can be read in minutes. Where the two inks meet they overprint, so the blue issue numeral multiplies to deep navy on the pink flood.

The system is about traceability as much as color. Items are numbered in a strict hanging margin; every insight cites them with pink ink blocks; following a citation prints a registration mark on the item. States are printed marks (a rotated stamp, a struck line, a registration mark), never new hues or soft UI chrome.

All styling lives in one stylesheet (`assets/css/site.css`) as custom properties on `:root`; new pages reuse its classes and tokens, never local colors.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks plus paper and ink; overprint (multiply) is the only blending.
Floods in the frame, calm in the column.
Numbers are first-class: big condensed Archivo numerals, tabular figures everywhere.
Square corners, solid rules, no shadows for elevation.
One load motion (masthead misregistration settle) and one interaction motion (registration mark); both off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Two Drums Rule
rules.body: Pink and blue are the only chromatic inks. A new color is a new drum the press doesn't have; express new meaning with a mark, a flood or an overprint instead.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Pink Rule
rules.body: Text on a pink flood is ink (#1D2340) or overprint navy; numerals on paper use pink-deep, never flat pink.

rules.name: The Overprint Rule
rules.body: Where blue sits on pink it uses `mix-blend-mode: multiply` (masthead numeral, favicon letter) or the precomputed overprint navy; never an arbitrary purple.

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Archivo's width and weight, not from more families: wide for words, condensed for numbers.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can sit in a column (items, issues, counts, citations) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Flat Press Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. No box-shadows, no blur; separate things with rules, floods and space.

dos: **Do** take every color from the `:root` tokens; pink and blue are the only inks.
**Do** set numerals on paper in pink-deep (#E0137E) and small blue text in blue-text (#00639F).
**Do** express states as printed marks (stamp, strike, registration mark) rather than new colors.
**Do** open new sections with a 2px ink rule and an uppercase Archivo section heading in blue-text.
**Do** keep the reading column at 64–68ch in Literata, and floods outside it.
**Do** wrap any new motion in the existing reduced-motion override.
donts: **Don't** add a third chromatic color, gradients beyond the pink-wash target fade, or a grain texture.
**Don't** set flat pink text or numerals on paper, or white text on pink.
**Don't** round corners or add drop shadows.
**Don't** animate the reading column beyond short hover transitions (0.15–0.2s) and the registration mark.
**Don't** hide citations or source links; every item number and source stays visible and linked.
